recognize_zh: 觸片（touch prep）上四顆原始細胞緊貼成簇，核質比極高、幾乎看不到細胞質，核圓至有凹陷、染色質均勻細緻，無顆粒；背景呈粉紫色蛋白質並散布許多透明脂肪空泡，符合急性淋巴芽細胞白血病的觸片表現，但費城染色體無法靠形態判斷。
features: Cluster of four blasts with very high N:C ratio and barely visible rim of cytoplasm
Round to slightly angulated nuclei with a small indentation in one cell
Finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background of pink-purple proteinaceous material with numerous clear lipid vacuoles, typical of a touch imprint
describe_en: Touch imprint preparation shows a cluster of four blasts in a pink-purple proteinaceous background containing numerous clear lipid vacuoles. The blasts have very high N:C ratios with only a thin rim of cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No granules or Auer rods are seen; the vacuoles lie in the background rather than within blast cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; BCR::ABL1 (Philadelphia chromosome) status cannot be determined morphologically and requires cytogenetic or molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts may be agranular but are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117 positive and negative for TdT with B-cell markers.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with intracytoplasmic punched-out vacuoles and are TdT-negative with surface light chains.
Blast morphology is identical; a prior chronic phase, basophilia or BCR::ABL1 in myeloid lineages indicate CML blast phase.
Hematogones are heterogeneous with a maturation continuum on flow cytometry and do not form monotonous clusters of blasts.
